Ashby...</h4><p class="c-PJLV c-hSaSvL c-hSaSvL-cBLpOj-size-2">As Ashby grew, I took on the full-time responsibility for our Analytics product. Within that scope, I've brought a dedicated focus to understanding our customers' product journey, starting at the sales demo through onboarding to the ongoing customer experience.

In working closely with many of our customers, I defined a standard set of dashboards for common use cases and needs in the recruiting space. These reports are now the starting point for every new customer and available immediately, providing access that otherwise would take many weeks of analyst effort. It's amazing to see a talent leader's joy when they get insights into their recruiting process they never had before.</p></div><div class="c-PJLV c-fixGjY c-PJLV-fVlWzK-spacing-3"><h4 class="c-PJLV c-erPqIQ c-erPqIQ-cnLwvN-size-2">Something I've helped the team with...</h4><p class="c-PJLV c-hSaSvL c-hSaSvL-cBLpOj-size-2">On a topic that's less about the day-to-day of product management, I wanted to help our team members get to know each other in our remote-first world. To help with that, I introduced a people intro slide deck where everyone gets a slide to share more about their personal interests. At all hands, every new employee introduces themselves with that slide. We've been able to learn a lot of interesting things that we would have otherwise never known, and it's a ton of fun!</p></div><div class="c-PJLV c-fixGjY c-PJLV-fVlWzK-spacing-3"><h4 class="c-PJLV c-erPqIQ c-erPqIQ-cnLwvN-size-2">Most surprising thing about Ashby...</h4><p class="c-PJLV c-hSaSvL c-hSaSvL-cBLpOj-size-2">I joined Ashby primarily because of the people - they're talented and are a rare selection of all-around great coworkers. Apart from that, having seen our product help, enable, and satisfy customers, I've had a growing pride in what we do and what we're building. It was a bit unexpected at first, but now I look at all the other companies in the world that I admire, and I have a sort of excitement at the idea of helping them effectively build the team they need. It's fun and hard work, we have so much to build, but it's really rewarding.</p></div></div></div><div class="c-lesPJm c-lesPJm-ibLqtIE-css"><button class="c-hugmbG c-hugmbG-fklrER-size-1 problems but to help them get more value from the product. What stood out most was how approachable and responsive everyone has been. I never felt like I had to figure things out alone. The culture of ownership and openness made it easy to ask questions and get context fast, which is rare in a fully remote setup.</p></div><div class="c-PJLV c-fixGjY c-PJLV-fVlWzK-spacing-3"><h4 class="c-PJLV c-erPqIQ c-erPqIQ-cnLwvN-size-2">Most surprising thing about Ashby...</h4><p class="c-PJLV c-hSaSvL c-hSaSvL-cBLpOj-size-2">The most surprising thing about Ashby has been how people consistently show up 101% for themselves, their work, and the team.
